sections.title: Selections for review, before tax
sections.note: Working selection record. Approval applies to the stated revision. This document is not a tax invoice.
sections.sql: select room,name,sku,specification,image_url,quantity,currency,price,revision,approval from schedule where project_id=$1 order by room,name

sections.title: Order details
sections.note: DRAFT. Review supplier terms and delivery details before sending. Prices exclude tax.
sections.sql: select o.reference,s.supplier,s.supplier_email,s.project,s.room,s.name,s.sku,s.specification,s.quantity,s.currency,s.unit_cost,s.cost,o.expected_date from orders o join schedule s on s.id=o.selection_id where o.id=$1

sections.title: Receipt
sections.sql: select o.reference,s.project,s.name,s.quantity,o.received_quantity,o.received_date,o.condition_note from orders o join schedule s on s.id=o.selection_id where o.id=$1

sections.title: Product issues and remedies
sections.sql: select i.note,i.resolution,i.created_at from issues i join orders o on o.selection_id=i.selection_id where o.id=$1

sections.title: Recorded decisions
sections.sql: select s.room,s.name,a.revision,a.decision,a.actor,a.evidence,a.created_at from approvals a join selections s on s.id=a.selection_id where s.project_id=$1 order by a.created_at
